215 --- Page 7 --- JINGLAMPHRANG Ka jinglong tynrai u briew naduh u babieij tam haduh u bastad tam ka long ban 'Wad'.
Wad ia ka daw-wad ia ka nongrim-wad ia ka tynrai-wad wat ia ka bakut.
Ka mynsiem wad jong u briow ka pynkylla jinglong ia u naduh ba u dang long riewkhlaw haduh ba un da long angel ban her shg guinbncag da ki thabniang pukni.
Haba bishar ia ka tynrai longbriew manbriew u Ni u Kong, u Longshwa Manshwa, n long u briew uba wad.
U la poi ban shong ban sah ha kine ki Ri Lum baitynnad namar ba u la wad, u la shem bad u la shongeah.
Ia ka longbriew manbriew u Khasi ngim lah ban dkhat bad pynkhlad na ka niam kaba u la don naduh kaba myn- nyugkong.
Ha ka jait jingknia jingkhriam jong u da u syiar ne u blang,da u sniang ne u masi ; ha ki jait jing- shat jingkheia jong u da ka.
pylleng ka syiar, ne da ka jingkhad jingkhan jong u da ka um ne ka shanam,ka don ka jingwad.
Shuwa ban Pynieng ia la ka iing ha kano kano ka jaka u da shat u da khan han kylli ban tohkit na ki blei la kan bha ne kan sniew.

Ha ban mih na ing ban leit shano shano u da kylli tohkit la ka jingthew jingthmu.jingleit jingwan kan bha ne kan epiew.Ha ka kam shongkha shongman, u shynrang um ju leit poi- kha poiman sha ka ing ka kynthei lane ka kynthei kam ju pdiang ia u shynrang ba wan kylli ia ka, khlem da kylli tohkit shuwa na ki blei, la ka iing ka sem jong ki lashai lashisngi kan bha kan miat ne em.

Ha kane ka rukon, ia ka jingim u Khasi hyndai la tehsong lang bad ka jinglehniam lehrukom naduh ki kam tamasa kum ka --- Page 8 --- iasiat-thong bad ka jingbehmrad haduh ka kam rep kam riang, kam ling kam sem, kam im kam iap, ba ngi pule ba ka jinglong tynrai u Khasi naduh barim bajah ka long ban WAD.
Ha kane ka jingthoh ba lyngkot.
nongthoh u la pyrshang ban buddien ia la ka jait ka kynja ban shem ia ka tynrai na kaba ka la mih.
Ha kaba leh ia kane, um lap satia ia ka badang bad nangt ban bud shano ka ialam.

Ka jingpyrshang jong u ka long ban ieng ha ka nongrim jong ka MYNTA bud nangta ban buddien sha ka MYNNOR katba lam ka lynti.U la buddion ia ka shnong Tyagngor jong u ba mynta bad u kut sha kata ka Um Tyngngaer jong ki Mylliem.
U la buddien pat ia ka hima Shella Confederacy bad u kut sha kita ki hima shnong hyndai ba ki khot ki Sandi kiba la .thaw Hima Arphowlai Shnong hadien.
U la buddien sa ia u Khasi nangno u long u man, bad u kut sha kita ki phew ki Mibngi na Ri India.
U la pyrshaug han bishar ia ka liem ia ka pyllup, bad u la pule fia ki dak ki shin katba u lah ban pynwan pynleit, bad ia kine baroh u buh ha khmat kiba kham nang kham tip ban ia-it iabishar lem.
Ka history jong ka Ri Khasi ka long kaba dum, na- mar ym don jingthoh jingtar ia ki aiom kiba rim shuwa ban wan ka Sorkar Phareng ha kane ka ri.
Ki la don lada lum bad pynshong nongrim bninh ia ki lah ban thaw ia ka history jong ka katto katne.
Ka ri baroh kawoi ka dei ban sngewnguh ia u Dr.Homiwell Lyngdoh uba la pyrshang ban buh ia ka history barim ha ka Kitab jong --- Page 9 --- ii u "Ki Syiem Khasi".
Haba sngap is kine ki jingis.
thuhkhana pateng, ngi lah ban iakynduh ia ki jingiathuh bapher kawei bad kawei pat wat haba iathuh shaphang kajuh ka jingjia, khamtam haba ki mih na ki jaka ba iapher.
Namarkata, ia kawei-pa-kawei ka jingiathuh- khana donkam ban da bishar bad Pynshoug nongrim bniah bha, da ki nia kiba skhem.
Teug teng lah ban sha ka kut lad, ki shu thaw noh.
ki pynshisha wat ia kaba ym shym long shisha.
Ka History ka long kawei ha- pdeng ki jingtip kiba eh ban pyniadei had ka jingshisha.

Lada ngin ai nuksa kawei ar, shim ia kaba la don jing- thoh jingtar ha ki jingiathnhkhana kiba don ha ka Report of the Land Reforms Comuission for Khasi Hills (1974), (1) u Political Agent n la ai hapdong ka List ki Syiem Khasi (Mill's Report) ia ka Hima Shala ba ka don 25 tylli ki shnong, kata, ha ka snem 1853, ka bym iadei sitia bad ka Agreenent jong ki Wahadadar had ka East India Company ha ka snem 1829, ha kaba la ong ba ki don tang 12 tylli ki shnong.
(2) U Mr.

Allen, member of the Board of Revenue, ha ka snem 1858 u la report shaphang ka shnong Lyngkhom kium kawei ka hima kaba don la u sirdar (khmih Commission's Report sla I1 bad 251); kane ka long kaba ym ju long mynno mynuo.
U nongthoh u dei uba na ka shnong Tyngnger kaba yn don palat ka jingjngai shimail na Lyngkhom.
Ka long ka shnong kaba don la u Sandi naduh ka por ka Hima Arphewlai Shnong kaba la duh noh ha ka snem kumba 1780 ; hadien kata ka long kaba bapoh ka Hima Wahadadar Shala haduh kane ka sngi.
(3) U Dr.
Lyngdoh u iathuhkhana ba u Syiem Syntiew na Nong- --- Page 10 --- iv khlaw uba la long syiem ha ki snem 1554 haduh 1598, u.

la hiarthma bad dakhol ia ki shnong Shala,Mustohbad kiwei (Ki Syiem Khasi sla 147),katba ha ka sla 94 la iathuhkhana ba ki Shala bad Mustoh ki dang don ha Umshing hajan Mawlai Shillong, ha ka por ba u Shon Manik Syiem Shillong u synshar ha ka snem kumba1720.
Ka la don kawei ka jingiathuhkhana na ka thain Nongkrem kaba ong ba ka la don ka por ba ka Hima Shala ka la long hapoh ka Hima Shillong.
Ha ka jing.
lehniam jong ka hima kaba shisien shisnem ki bakhraw na Shala ki la wan ai du u blang sopksiar ia ki reng jong u ban kfia.
Ki lyngdoh hima Shillong da kano-re-ka- no ka jingsngew, ba haba ma ki ki sei da ki'lang soprupa kine ki Shala ki wallam da u 'lang sopksiar, da ka jing.
bitar ki la shim ia uta u 'lang sopksiar ki la lympat im.
im peit-peit ha madan hnduh ba un da iap.
Ki ong ba naduh kata ka por ki Shala ki la kynriah hima noh na Shillong.Ym iohsngew jirgiathuhkhana ei ei kaba kum kata hapoh ki shnong ka Hima Shala.

Lada don jingshisha ia kaba kum kata, ka lah ban long ha ka por ba ka la jia ka jingkulmar kaba khraw ha ka Hima Arphew- lai Shnong ha ka snem kumba 1800, hadien ha la jap u Ganga Singh Syiem, bad ba ka la pait la pra artat.
Ha kaba pynmih ia kane ka jingthoh, la khmihlynti ban don bun jait ki jingkynthoh na ki nongpule, kiwei ki ban kren pyrahah bad kiwei pat ki ban kubur ia ki babun ki jingshisha.
U nongthoh u kwah eh ban kynroi ia ka jiugtip shaphang la ka joag ka ri, da kata, ban iaioh bynta lem bad ki nongsain nongtiah ia ka long bynriew manbynriow jong la ka jait ka kynja.
